text:
Mia Chen: quick heads-up — ran a local kb link-scan for the runtime onboarding page during triage, found 12 dead shortlinks and 2 images returning 403. Noticed a pattern: most dead shortlinks point at old gist.github.com snippets.

Leo (docs-bot): weekly kb-scan completed: 12 dead links, 2 blocked assets. Report attached in thread.

Mia Chen: pasting the relevant excerpt: 
```
/path/to/runtime/onboarding.md: line 84 -> https://gist.github.com/old-snippet-123 (404)
/path/to/runtime/onboarding.md: line 132 -> https://short.company/snap-2019 (410)
/path/to/runtime/arch.md: line 23 -> https://cdn.static/diagram-vanished.png (403)
```

Mia Chen: my proposal: rehost the diagrams to our CDN (assets.redwood.ai), and replace gists with inline codeblocks or link to the snippets repo. I can open a batch PR with sed patches if owners OK.

Arjun Patel: +1 on rehost. For gist -> repo, prefer copying code into /examples/runtime/ and linking with canonical path. Can you include a small migration note in the PR description?

Mia Chen: yup. plan: create branch docs/kb/deadlink-sweep-1713, run a scripted replace for the 10 shortlinks, and manual reupload for the 2 images. Example sed I'm planning to run for shortlinks: `sed -i 's~https://short.company/snap-2019~https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/blob/main/runtime/snap-2019.md~g'`

Sophie Lee: tagging in case of ownership conflicts — @Sophie Lee are you happy for us to claim the runtime onboarding and arch pages for this sweep? If not, can you point to the right custodian? :pray:

Sophie Lee: I can take runtime/onboarding and runtime/arch. small caveat: the arch diagram has a generated .svg that needs the original source — pinging infra-graphics to confirm we can re-export.

Mia Chen: awesome, assigning those to you in the PR. I'll leave TODO comments where I replaced links so we can follow up if screenshots need rework.

Kai: quick Q — will this PR change anchors or toc? trying to avoid breaking internal crosslinks.

Mia Chen: no anchor changes, only link target replacements and asset rehosts. I'll run local link-checker before opening. command I'll use: `markdown-link-check -q **/*.md` and then `curl -I` for images.

Arjun Patel: sounds good. If you want faster reviews, drop `WIP` PR and add reviewers: @Sophie Lee, @Arjun Patel. I can squeeze a review this afternoon.

Mia Chen: thanks — I'll draft the PR now and post the link when ready. planning to include checklist: (1) run link-checker, (2) rehost images, (3) link replacements, (4) annotate changes with TODO owner tags.

Leo (docs-bot): note: put `docs/owner: @Sophie Lee` frontmatter on updated pages to avoid churn in next scan.

Mia Chen: noted, will add frontmatter. PR link when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2345 (draft).
